home.faqSubtitle: Everything you need to know about Wednesday drops

faqs.a: Our algorithm looks at more than just photos. It analyzes interests, values, and dating preferences to help you meet someone you will actually enjoy talking to.
Yes. To keep the community safe and relevant, we only support people from verified Hong Kong university institutions.

faqs.q: Why only one match a week?
faqs.a: Infinite lists lead to fatigue. By giving you one intentional match every Wednesday, we help you focus on really getting to know one person.

faqs.q: What if I don't like my match?
faqs.a: You’re always in control. Provide feedback after every match. If you select 'Pass' or 'Rematch', the algorithm learns your taste. Safety and comfort are our priority.
We suggest meeting at public campus spots like HKU's Book Cafe or CUHK's Lake Ad Excellentiam. Keep it low-pressure, public, and around an hour for the first time.

items.title: Hong Kong | Kitchen Social: Cook Dinner Together
items.summary: Random teams, cooking tasks, a relaxed dinner, and easy conversation. No perfect cooking skills needed.
content: Skip the usual weekend scroll and step into the kitchen. Everyone will join a small team and build a shared dinner together.
From prep work and plating to tasting and post-dinner chat, each step makes meeting new people feel natural.
Great for students who want low-pressure social time, food, and a reason to meet people across campus.

items.title: Love Growth Lab | Crush Signals & Relationship Patterns
items.summary: A practical session for understanding how you like, avoid, signal, and choose in early-stage dating.
content: This is a relaxed but useful online workshop for anyone trying to understand their dating rhythm.
We will use DopaMine persona types, crush scenarios, and messaging examples to unpack your patterns.
You will leave with a simple relationship observation checklist for your next connection.

schedule.desc: Look at attraction, avoidance, expression, and expectation.
